addition.item: Added support for specifying the thumb as a fingering using uppercase T in scale diagram shortcodes.

change.item: Refactored Fretboard Diagram colors into dedicated --fretboarddiagram-* CSS variables, allowing Hoary Theme Switcher to override the diagram colors cleanly in dark mode.

addition.item: Initial release of the Fretboard Diagram content plugin. Supports shortcodes for responsive SVG guitar scale and chord diagrams. Also allows configurable chord and scale diagram widths.
